item.title: Scleral lenses a final solution for keratoconus?
item.description: The keratoconus advanced patient has a great option called Scleral lenses; they help people that have become intolerant to other corneal lenses. New designs and materials make these lenses better every day and with proper management, you can adapt to them quickly. If you try them, Scleral lenses are probably the last option for us with advanced keratoconus, before the use of other more drastic measures.

item.title: Contact Lenses for Keratoconus
item.description: There are “basically” three types of lenses, corneal lenses like the Rose K lenses; scleral lenses like the Digiform K lens, and Hybrid lenses like the Synergeyes lens.
